DRUMFISH-NEWBORN_WING.description: At the start of the first turn of combat, add one [gold]Kindling Feather[/gold] to your draw pile and one to your hand.
DRUMFISH-NEWBORN_WING.title: Newborn Wing
DRUMFISH-FRIED_WING.description:
At the start of the first turn of combat, add one [gold]Kindling Feather+[/gold] to your draw pile and one to your hand.
At the start of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Thorns[/gold].
DRUMFISH-FRIED_WING.title: Fried Wing
